name: naive
note: naive is HTTP/2 CONNECT — a TCP stream. The pack's outbound asks for udp_over_tcp (version 2), so app datagrams ride a CONNECT stream to the relay, whose naive inbound accepts that with no configuration (sing-box 1.13.12 protocol/naive/inbound.go): udp=pass, asserted under every censor scenario like any other family. It was udp=blocked — a declared product limitation, FINDINGS FAM-6 — until the minter set it. Names resolve through the tunnel too (dns=pass): with udp_over_tcp the engine no longer answers UDP/53 itself for this route. The client needs Cronet; run.sh stages the linux build that sing-box's own dependency (cronet-go) ships as a Go module.
